title: biscutella sempervirens subsp. montana
intro: Biscutella sempervirens subsp. montana, commonly known as Mountain Biscuit Root, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular diseases and cancer. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of Biscutella sempervirens subsp. montana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
